scientific_question: On the official Forest10 test split, do Nominal- and PESS-selected pairwise-MCV resource sets have different PostgreSQL cardinality-estimation Q1 errors, when selection is calibrated only from official valid data?

scope.template_overlap: allowed; claim is generalization under the official AreCEL split, not to unseen templates
scope.other_datasets: future replications, not prerequisites for this first milestone

candidate_universe.source: merged PR #68 workload-derived Forest10 valid-split discovery
candidate_universe.ordering: published Issue #67 report order, equivalent to lexicographic unordered pairs in Forest10 source-schema column order

selection.source_model: corrected-log PR #58 run_formal.py at pinned commit 76106024611ae91505f1f05bdc35aed44d9c38c4
selection.constraint: resource-set cardinality <= B; every budget includes Empty
selection.nominal: greedy matching over selected, query-available edges in frozen candidate order
selection.pess: maximum loss over every inclusion-maximal matching of selected, query-available edges
selection.objective: sum of task-wise frozen validation losses over all 10000 valid queries

corrected_log_coefficients.alpha: ln(n0_i/T_i), where n0_i is the positive Empty pre-clamp estimate
corrected_log_coefficients.edge_coefficient: b_e_i=ln(n_e_i/n0_i), where n_e_i is that eligible singleton's positive pre-clamp estimate
corrected_log_coefficients.rationalization: PR #58 uses Decimal natural log at precision 80, quantized half-even to 1e-18, then parsed as Fraction; exact enumeration is over these rationalized inputs

selection.enumeration: complete exact enumeration of every feasible subset; no heuristic, truncation, or solver approximation
selection.objective_arithmetic: exact Fraction over the rationalized alpha and b inputs produced by the pinned corrected-log model
selection.ties: retain all exact minimizers; choose the smallest-cardinality minimizer, then lexicographically earliest tuple of candidate-order positions for deployment

current_resource_decisions.B0: Both Nominal and PESS select the unique feasible resource set, Empty; its validation objective is not computed because alpha requires valid calibration Plan Rows.
current_resource_decisions.B2_B3: NOT_COMPUTED: the required valid-query singleton/Empty calibration Plan Rows are unavailable without PostgreSQL calibration, which is prohibited in this phase.

calibration_inputs_and_boundary.empty: one Empty configuration per each of the 10000 official valid queries
calibration_inputs_and_boundary.singleton: measure each statically eligible candidate only on valid queries supporting that candidate
calibration_inputs_and_boundary.truth: official valid truth only may contribute to alpha, b, objective, or selection
calibration_inputs_and_boundary.combined_label_pickle_deserialization: permitted by researcher clarification; test labels must not influence calibration, selection, model/solver decisions, or tuning
calibration_inputs_and_boundary.this_phase: no PostgreSQL measurements or EXPLAIN; no valid truth or test outcomes were opened for this implementation/preflight

evaluation_adapter.input: one ordinary EXPLAIN (FORMAT JSON) result per query and each distinct deployed resource set, after separate researcher execution approval
evaluation_adapter.sample_policy: reuse one pinned ANALYZE sample per dataset across treatment sets; record and compare PG build, table/schema, GUC, target, sample seed/identity, and setup metadata before claiming paired comparability
evaluation_adapter.estimate: integer Plan Rows at the top-level Plan only
evaluation_adapter.zeros: Q1 is defined for nonnegative integer estimate/truth including zero; retain/report zero-zero, estimate-only-zero, truth-only-zero explicitly
evaluation_adapter.invalids: missing, negative, non-integer, or malformed Plan Rows/truth are unresolved and must not be silently dropped
evaluation_adapter.primary_summary: per-query Q1, nearest-rank P95 per policy
secondary: nearest-rank P50, P99, and maximum Q1
mean |ln(estimate/truth)| on strictly positive estimate/truth pairs, with denominator reported
paired per-query PESS versus Nominal Q1: benefit if PESS Q1 is lower, harm if higher, tie if equal, on the common valid test-query set
evaluation_adapter.physical_claim_boundary: Plan Rows/Q1 evaluates estimates; it does not identify which extended-statistics OID PostgreSQL selected

preflight.test_upper_bound_reason: 10000 official test queries times at most five distinct sets: Empty plus Nominal/PESS selections for B=2 and B=3; B=0 is Empty and duplicate sets are deduplicated

source_pins.postgresql_build_and_runtime: NOT_VERIFIED; pg_config and psql were not found on PATH during outcome-free preflight

phase_boundary.next_step: researcher review of code, preflight, calibration plan cap, runtime/storage feasibility, and pinned PostgreSQL build before separate execution approval
